name: Inter State Oil Carrier Limited
about: Inter State Oil Carrier Limited operates as a transporter of bulk liquids in India. Its fleet includes single and multi-compartment tankers, SS tankers, and integrated tanker trailers. The company transports white edible oils; chemicals, such as methanol, emulsion, cyclo-pentene, acid slurry, acetic acid, acetone, formalin, linear alkylbenzene, mixed xylene, solvents, naptha, exxsol D-8, exxsol KD-80, phenol, C-9, C10, chryso AMA, bentone SP oil, cyclopentane, MEK, butyl acetate, MIBK, sodium silicate, bio-diesel, toluene, n-butanol, etc.; as well as LPG, butane 1, proylene, propane, butadine, and C4. It also transports oils, such as castor seed oil, coconut oil, linseed oil, palm oil, PFAD, RBD palm oil, refined soyabean oil, rice bran oil, sesame oil, and soya crude. In addition, the company invests in shares and securities. Inter State Oil Carrier Limited was founded in 1970 and is based in Kolkata, India.
